name: TinChest

CHANGE ONLY the material colour palette across the entire object: pale icy silver-blue ceramic, bright silver hardware and ice-blue vents. Replace ALL copper/terracotta body colours with this tier's main colour, not only trim. Preserve exactly the original straight-on front-down geometry, overall squat width/height proportions, flattened top, three recessed narrow front vents, structural frame, four silver rivets and two little feet. Retain the high-quality pixel cluster shading and highlights. Keep tiny wear and patina subtle and harmonious with the new material. Do not introduce new ornaments, don't redesign or rotate, no hinge or lock, no text, no floor. One centred isolated prop with transparent background. Maintain crisp enlarged pixel-art style, same detail density and framing as input.
